whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Dojo Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.6★ reviews on Bailey Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and menu discovery.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature cafe menu, aur location/directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dojocafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Dojo Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (The Dojo Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and menu showcase for your Bailey Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
